personality_one_liner: A stable, high-clarity operational command center that prioritizes legibility, precise Arabic RTL layout, and tactile data visualization over decorative chrome.

spacing.rule: Generous comfortable padding for touch targets on field. Padding defaults to lg (16).

do's: Use for bottom tab bar to allow scrolling content to bleed behind
Use for sticky headers on long scrolling dashboard views
dont's: Do not use on data cards or charts
Do not use if it impacts Arabic text legibility

screens.name: Dashboard (الرئيسية)
screens.purpose: High-level KPI overview showing fleet status, active violations, and maintenance alerts.

states.loading: Centered spinner with 'جاري تحميل البيانات...' text.
states.empty: Illustration of a clean garage with 'لا توجد بيانات حالياً'.
states.error: Error icon with 'حدث خطأ في الاتصال' and a retry CTA.

screens.layout: 4-KPI hero row at top (Total Vehicles, Active Maintenance, Pending Violations, Leaves). Below: Traffic-light status modules for immediate action, followed by a Bar Chart for Violations and Pie Chart for Maintenance Status. Single column scrolling.

screens.name: Vehicles & Maintenance (السيارات والصيانة)
screens.purpose: List of vehicles mapped to locations, including maintenance history, price lists, and condition photos.

states.empty: Vehicle image block + 'لم يتم إضافة سيارات بعد'. CTA to Add Vehicle.

screens.layout: Search/Filter sticky header (Glass). Cards displaying Vehicle ID, Status (Green/Amber/Red), and Location. Tap card -> opens detailed bottom sheet with maintenance cost history and photo grid.

screens.name: Violations (المخالفات)
screens.purpose: Log and track traffic violations with attached camera proof photos and status.

states.empty: Traffic light empty state + 'سجل المخالفات نظيف'.

screens.layout: List of violation cards. Each card shows Date, Amount, Vehicle, and a thumbnail of the violation photo. Hero area includes a small line chart showing violation trends over the last 6 months.

screens.name: Employees & Locations (الموظفين والمقرات)
screens.purpose: Directory of headquarters, assigned employees, and their active/upcoming leaves.
screens.layout: Segmented control at top (Locations | Employees). Employees view shows list with 'Leave Status' badge (Active/Upcoming/Working). Locations view shows HQ addresses with vehicle counts.

hero_fleet.alt: Commercial trucks on road representing fleet

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The app MUST be designed with strict Right-To-Left (RTL) formatting. Use `I18nManager.forceRTL(true)` in setup and ensure all `flexDirection: 'row'` layouts logically flow from right to left.
Typography: Use `Tajawal` or `Cairo` for Arabic fonts. Load them via Expo fonts to ensure legibility.
Navigation: All 'forward' chevrons in list items must point left (CareLeft instead of CaretRight) due to RTL layout.
Palette: Adhere strictly to the Moss Green & Rust palette provided. Absolutely NO BLUES, INDIGOS, or PURPLES as per core anti-pattern rules. Use #3A4F2C as the primary action color.
Image Treatment: All images mapped in the app (e.g., violation photos, vehicle photos) MUST use a gradient scrim if text is overlaid, ensuring readability.
Components: Ensure touch targets are at least 44x44pt (critical for field workers).
Data Viz: Implement responsive charts (e.g., using `react-native-chart-kit` or `react-native-gifted-charts`) for the dashboard's violation trends and maintenance tracking.
